answer: Agents must embed an ivory token in a sonnet-locked garden vault; each vault’s solution requires solving a quadratic fit to noon’s shadow. Sybils must re-render the garden’s photonic lattice, paying 1.3 gigaseconds of laser writes per head—the garden’s soil feedback slows bulk solvers by 15%, degrading parity checks linearly. The cost is unyielding because shadow angles shift unpredictably across epochs.
